basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old single mom living in Spartanburg, trying to balance my time between raising my toddler and learning Unity3D. I work part-time at a local coffee shop, and in my spare moments, I delve into game development as a new hobby. I love watching animated series like Glitch Techs with my son. I'm still figuring out what I want in terms of future relationships and family. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings when my son is asleep. Currently, I'm navigating the complexities of dating while being a single parent.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of Unity3D, which I started learning online through free tutorials and community forums. My interest in game development was sparked by my love for video games and animation. I also frequently explore parenting and lifestyle topics to better manage my life as a single mom.
